note: Third shop of the B07 covered arcade (glass skylight, white plaster pilasters, dark oak dado, as on the exterior): the fashion boutique, with dove-grey and mint striped wallpaper and a grey-and-white marble diamond floor. LANDMARK: the huge gilded triple mirror. The doorway on the far left shows the navy bookshop (way back); the doorway on the far right shows the slate-grey hardware shop with hanging chains (next shop). Feminine nouns left of the knight, masculine from the knight rightwards. Zoom: the dressing corner at the gilded mirror (z1).
